en.topic_title: Over 153,000 students, staff affected in Canvas data breach, Hong Kong privacy watchdog says
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong’s privacy watchdog has found that more than 153,000 students and staff from four educational institutions in the city were affected in a global cyberattack on online learning platform Canvas in May.



The Canvas logo. Photo: Canvas by Instructure.
